protocol: Common early-checkpoint physics evaluation, not a reconstruction of historical training configuration. Model weights and each model's serialized observation normalizers are loaded; no optimizer or training update is executed. Deterministic default-joint-pose reset with synchronized targets, fixed 10 ms delay. See explicit perturbation metadata. Stairs use a dedicated capped outer landing; retain real phase and full collision-hull entry, end after supported landing dwell, safe tile endpoint, or physical/25s termination.
